action-dante-dump: dump the contents of this wiki
action-dante-dbdump: dump the database of this wiki
action-dante-dbrestore: restore the database of this wiki
right-dante-dump: Dump pages, uploaded files and the database of the wiki
right-dante-restore: Restore pages and uploaded files into the wiki
right-dante-dbdump: Dump the database of the wiki
right-dante-dbrestore: Restore the database of the wiki
dante-database-dump-intro: This page allows you to produce a dump of the '''entire database''' of this dantewiki. For more information consult [[Help:DanteBackup]].
dante-page-dump-intro: This page allows you to produce a dump of this dantewiki. For more information consult [[Help:DanteBackup]].
dante-page-restore-intro: This page allows you to restore a dump of this dantewiki. Please select a file to be used for restoring. For more information consult [[Help:DanteRestore]].
select-local-file: Select a file from your local machine
restore-from-aws: Select one of the following AWS S3 files
header: Identification: What is the name of the dump?
srcfeatures: Source: What shall the dump include?
rc: Database:Shall we produce a database dump?
rf: Files: Shall uploaded files be included?
rb: Pages: Which pages shall be included in the page dump?
ra: Revisions: Which revisions shall be included in the page dump?
dumpform-up: Files: For the uploaded files, include:
features: Features: Which further things do you require?
target: Target: Where shall the dump be stored?
dumpform-debug: Show debug output (only advanced users and only for AWS S3)
dbdumpform-target: Where shall the database dump be stored?
dbdumpform-features: Choose features of the database dump:
restform-restore-from-s3: Select a page dump file for restoring
restore-from-url: Enter a URL for restoring from the file it designates
restore-from-github: GitHub repository from which the contents are restored
restore-from-scp: SCP location from which the file is restored
aws-prefs-key: Access Key of an Amazon AWS IAM User with rights to write to S3. See [[Help:DanteBackup]].
aws-prefs-skey: Secret Access Key of that Amazon AWS IAM User. Keep confidential. See [[Help:DanteBackup]].
aws-prefs-bucket: Name of an AWS S3 bucket. Example: dantebackup.iuk.one. See [[Help:DanteBackup]].
aws-prefs-region: Name of an AWS region. Example: eu-central-1. See [[Help:DanteBackup]].
aws-prefs-encpw: Encryption password for user-controlled encryption before S3 upload. See [[Help:DanteBackup]].
prefs-ssh-host: Name and domain (FQDN) of host used for SSH backup. See [[Help:DanteBackup]].
prefs-ssh-dump-user: User name for user on SSH backup host which receives the dump. See [[Help:DanteBackup]].
prefs-ssh-dump-pw: Password for user on SSH backup host which receives the dump. See [[Help:DanteBackup]].
prefs-ssh-restore-user: User name for user on SSH backup host which provides the dumped data. See [[Help:DanteBackup]].
prefs-ssh-restore-pw: Password for user on SSH backup host which provides the dumped data. See [[Help:DanteBackup]].
prefs-ssh-encpw: Encryption password for user-controlled encryption before SSH upload. See [[Help:DanteBackup]].
prefs-label-git-branch: Name of branch to be used
prefs-git-owner: GitHub user or organization owning the repository. Used as default by Restore from GITHUB in [[Special:DanteRestore]].
prefs-git-repository: Name of the GitHub repository. Used as default by Restore from GITHUB in [[Special:DanteRestore]].
prefs-git-branch: Branch of the repository, for example master. Used as default by Restore from GITHUB in [[Special:DanteRestore]].
help-filter: Removes all hidden contents. See [[Help:Hidden Contents]]
help-zip: Compression with gzip makes the dump file considerably smaller. A restore recognizes compressed files by the .gz suffix and decompresses them automatically.
help-enc: Encryption ensures privacy of content on dump storage media. Set password in [[Special:Preferences]] in tab DanteWiki. Make sure to remember the password used in the dump, as without it you cannot restore the contents of the dump file.
help-encpw: Password for encrypting this dump. Leave empty to use the password set in [[Special:Preferences]] in tab DanteWiki. Remember the password used, as without it you cannot restore the contents of the dump file.
help-pass: Password as set in [[Special:Preferences]]. You can change it but must make sure to remember it in connection with the dump since without it you cannot restore the contents of the dump file.
help-enc-db: Encryption ensures privacy of content on dump storage media. Set password in [[Special:Preferences]] in tab DanteWiki. Make sure to remember the password used in the dump, as without it you cannot restore the contents of the dump file. If a password is set for the user and you do a database dump without encryption then the password is visible as part of the database dump.
